title: Galaheim
body:
# Welcome to the World of **Galaheim**

This is a fantasy-based modpack that includes:
- A plethora of creatures
- Deeply immersive ambience
- Otherworldy biomes
- Breathtaking scenery with the use of Distant Horizons
- New and enhanced systems to create challenge
- A multitude of new gear to find
- Dangerous structures to conquer
- And much more...


The Overworld, Nether, and End have been carefully restructured to portray the magical and extraordinary world that this modpack aims to create.

For the best experience, play on a modded server.
